title: Ividiyo Elandiwe Ayidlali? Izimbangela Nezixazululo
description: Ividiyo oyilandile ayidlali? Thola izimbangela, kusukela ekulandeni okungakaqedi kuya ku-codec ye-HEVC, bese ulandela izixazululo ezilula.
photo2Caption: Zama enye inketho yevidiyo noma esinye isidlali.
body:
Ividiyo ilande kahle, kodwa lapho uyivula kuvela umlayezo wephutha, isikrini esimnyama, noma isithombe esima-ima? Ungapheli amandla ngokushesha. Kunezimbangela ezimbalwa ezivamile zokuthi kungani ividiyo elandiwe ingadlali, futhi eziningi zazo ungazilungisa wena ngemizuzu embalwa. Ake sizihlole ngayinye ngayinye.

Ukuze wazi, amafayela e-MP4 alandwe ku-I Need Save anobude besikhathi obulungile futhi adlala kuma-app e-gallery. Ngakho uma kunenkinga, imbangela ivamise ukuba yenye yalezi zinto ezilandelayo.

1. Ukulanda akukaqedi

Amanye amavidiyo adinga ukucutshungulwa kuqala ngaphambi kokulandwa, isibonelo ividiyo nomsindo wayo kuyahlanganiswa, noma i-stream iguqulelwa ku-MP4. Ngesikhathi lokhu kwenzeka, inkinobho izobonisa okuthi Iyalungisa…. Uma ikhasi livaliwe noma uxhumano lunqamuka ngaphambi kokuthi ukulanda kuqede, ifayela lingonakala noma lingaphelele.

Isixazululo: landa ividiyo futhi, linda kuze kuqale ukulanda ngokuzenzakalelayo, futhi uqinisekise ukuthi kuqediwe ohlwini lokulanda lwe-browser ngaphambi kokuvula ifayela.

2. I-codec yevidiyo ayisekelwa amafoni amadala

Amanye amavidiyo e-TikTok asebenzisa i-codec ye-HEVC (H.265). Le codec yenza amafayela asebenze kahle, kodwa amafoni amadala kakhulu angase angakwazi ukuyidlala kahle. Izimpawu zingaba yisithombe esima-ima, isikrini esimnyama esinomsindo kuphela, noma i-app ye-gallery yenqaba ukuvula ifayela.

Isixazululo: landa futhi bese ukhetha enye inketho yevidiyo ekhona. Inketho ye-H.264 idlala cishe kuwo wonke amadivayisi. Ungakhetha futhi i-resolution ephansi ukuze ibe lula. Funda nendatshana ethi umehluko wekhwalithi yevidiyo engu-360p, 720p, ne-1080p ukuze ikusize ukhethe.

3. Ividiyo ayikaveli ku-Gallery

Ku-Android, amafayela alondolozwa kufolda ethi Downloads (Okulandiwe), futhi i-app ye-Gallery kwesinye isikhathi idinga isikhashana ukuze iyibonise. Ungase ucabange ukuthi ividiyo yonakele, kanti ifayela nje alikafundwa.

Isixazululo: vula ifayela ngqo ku-app yokuphatha amafayela noma ohlwini lokulanda lwe-browser. Ungalinda futhi kancane, bese uvula kabusha i-app ye-Gallery.

4. Ku-iPhone, ividiyo isesekhona ku-app ethi Files

Abasebenzisi be-iPhone ne-iPad abasebenzisa i-Safari bavame ukudideka ngoba ividiyo ayikho ku-app ethi Photos. Lokho kungenxa yokuthi amafayela alandiwe angena ku-app ethi Files → Downloads (Okulandiwe).

  1. Vula i-app ethi Files bese ungena kufolda ethi Downloads.
  2. Thepha ividiyo oyilandile.
  3. Thepha okuthi Share (Yabelana).
  4. Khetha Save Video (Londoloza Ividiyo).

Ngemuva kwalokho, ividiyo ingadlalwa ku-app ethi Photos. Umhlahlandlela ophelele mayelana nendawo yamafayela usendatshaneni ethi amafayela alandiwe alondolozwa kuphi.

5. Okulandiwe akusiyo ividiyo

Ohlwini lwezinketho, ngaphandle kwevidiyo kukhona nokuthi Umsindo kanye Isithombe / Isithonjana. Uma ngephutha ukhethe umsindo, okulondoloziwe kuyifayela lomsindo elingenaso isithombe. Uma ukhethe isithonjana, okulondoloziwe yisithombe sekhava kuphela.

Isixazululo: phinda inqubo futhi uqinisekise ukuthi ucindezela inketho yevidiyo enekhwalithi oyifunayo.

6. Indawo yokugcina igcwele noma isidlali sinenkinga

Isitoreji esicishe sagcwala singenza ifayela lilondolozwe lingaphelele. Ama-app okudlala noma amasistimu okusebenza amadala nawo kwesinye isikhathi aba nenkinga lapho evula amavidiyo athile.

Isixazululo: khulula isikhala esincane sokugcina, buyekeza isistimu ne-app ye-gallery uma kukhona izibuyekezo, bese ulanda ividiyo futhi.

Isinyathelo esisheshayo esivame ukusiza: susa ifayela elinenkinga, kopisha futhi ilinki enkinobhweni ethi Yabelana, bese ulanda futhi ngenye inketho yekhwalithi.

Indlela yokulanda futhi ngendlela efanele

  1. Ku-app yezokuxhumana, thepha okuthi Yabelana (Share) bese uthi Kopisha ilinki (Copy link).
  2. Vula ikhasi lokulanda le-I Need Save.
  3. Namathisela ilinki noma uthephe okuthi Namathisela, bese ucindezela okuthi Landa.
  4. Khetha inketho yevidiyo efanele, bese ulinda uma kuvela okuthi Iyalungisa….

Khumbula ukuthi okuqukethwe okuyimfihlo, okudinga ukungena ngemvume, noma okukhawulelwe ngokwesifunda akukwazi ukulandwa. Londoloza amavidiyo ukuze uwasebenzise wena kuphela, futhi uma ufuna ukuwaphinda uwathumele, cela imvume kumdali futhi ubalule igama lakhe.

Imibuzo evame ukubuzwa

Kungani kunomsindo kodwa isithombe simnyama?

Ngokuvamile kungenxa yokuthi ifoni ayiyisekeli i-codec yaleyo vidiyo, isibonelo i-HEVC kudivayisi endala kakhulu. Zama ukulanda futhi ngenye inketho yevidiyo.

Ingabe ubude bevidiyo elandiwe bungaba namaphutha?

Amafayela e-MP4 avela ku-I Need Save anobude besikhathi obulungile. Uma ubude bubukeka bungajwayelekile, kungenzeka ukuthi ukulanda akukaqedi, ngakho zama ukulanda futhi.

Ividiyo iyadlala ku-laptop kodwa hhayi efonini, kungani?

Kungenzeka kakhulu ukuthi kungenxa yomehluko wokusekelwa kwama-codec kulawa madivayisi womabili. Zama ukukhetha enye inketho yevidiyo lapho ulanda ividiyo ozoyibuka efonini yakho.
